name: Hardware-Accelerated Gaussian Rasterization
definition: A hardware-algorithm co-design that augments standard triangle rasterizers with dedicated units for Gaussian projection and blending, achieving an order of magnitude speedup in the rasterization stage.
summary: Hardware-Accelerated Gaussian Rasterization is a hardware-algorithm co-design that augments standard triangle rasterizers with dedicated units for Gaussian projection and blending, achieving an order of magnitude speedup over software-based methods.
